experiment.adaptation_scope: one shared posterior with paired batched workload updates per method and seed
experiment.aggregation: geometric mean fraction of held-out exhaustive reference
experiment.budget_one_invariant: Parhelion and multi-source retrieval query and recommend the identical retrieval anchor at budget 1, charged once to each method.
experiment.conditional_on: the fixed historical H100 timing matrix, 96-workload corpus, frozen source archive, selected v2 parameters, and 30-seed campaign
experiment.confidence_interval: Stochastic curves use normal 95% seed intervals after equal-fold averaging; the paired primary AUC1..8 endpoint uses a two-sided 95% Student-t interval; deterministic curves use fold variation.
experiment.recommendation: best measured bank-0 incumbent for every live adaptive method
experiment.retrieval_distance: frozen normalized Euclidean distance over log2(M, N, K)
experiment.reward: log-TFLOP/s from the bank-0 selected-configuration latency
experiment.sampling_unit: paired policy seed after equal-fold averaging
experiment.target_budget_unit: distinct bank-0 configuration probes per held-out workload

limitations: Every new algorithmic contrast is post-hoc exploratory and has no multiplicity-adjusted superiority claim.
Monte Carlo intervals condition on the fixed historical matrix, corpus, archive, and campaign.
The source archive cost is paid before target tuning and is not included in target probes.
Replay reports simulated online query efficiency from a physically exhaustive target matrix.
The curated 36-action manifest is not the full space of legal Triton configurations.
Steady-state kernel timings omit compilation and end-to-end serving overhead.
Final-domain status is caller-declared; replay cannot independently prove that the target was untouched before this call.
Hyperparameters and the primary comparator are selected externally; this function never selects them or branches on a GPU name.
Three independent timing banks reduce leakage but do not model production interference.
The shape-disjoint L4 nearest baseline is v1-inspired and not an exact reproduction of the published v1 family-only replay.
methodology: Post-hoc exploratory causal ablations on the immutable Parhelion v2 matrix. No H100-side parameter selection or recollection is performed.

provenance.budget_one_anchor: Parhelion and multi-source retrieval use the same independently frozen retrieval rank-one action
provenance.hyperparameters: externally selected and frozen before this replay
provenance.primary_comparator: caller-supplied and frozen before target evaluation
provenance.reward: log-TFLOP/s for every source and target posterior observation
provenance.selection: frozen T4 choices; no H100-side selection
provenance.single_source_nearest: parameter-free k=1 retrieval bound to first declared source L4

source_cost.disclosure: Policies use only bank-0 source observations from leakage-safe rows. All physical source acquisition and source reference/evaluation banks are outside the target online-query budget.

target_collection_cost.adaptation_scope: Each adaptive method uses one shared posterior and a paired, batched workload order per budget round; workloads are not tuned as independent posteriors.
target_collection_cost.budget_b_formula: Per live method: target workloads in one fold times b (24*b for each frozen four-family corpus fold), and all workloads times b (96*b across four folds).
target_collection_cost.disclosure: Replay simulates online selection from an already collected exhaustive target matrix. Physical collection includes all three banks and is not reduced by the reported online query budget.

workload_endpoint_summary.seed_averaging: arithmetic mean within each workload before corpus quantiles
